Messages.Author: wumpus
Messages.Body:
Howdy,

Beatrice During wrote:

> Kiss of Lachesis and Flaming candle - there is a nice trick, especially
> in a multiaction deck.

There appears to be a single thread discussing this interaction
(actually, it's about Filchware's and the Candle), and I cannot tell
from the context there whether this combo (or the Grasp the Ghostly
variant) actually works or not. LSJ?

A corollary question: If using Grasp the Ghostly works, and you burn a
Ghostly Candle to use its power, does the Candle go back to the (other
Methuselah's) ash heap, or does the burning of the Candle also burn the
Pathos counters and thus remove the Candle from the game entirely?

Flaming Candle
Equipment. The vampire with this equipment may burn 1 blood when he or
she declares an action. If he or she does so, vampires cannot block
this action, and the candle is burned. Only one Flaming Candle can be
played in a game.

Grasp the Ghostly
+1 stealth action. [nec] Move a non-unique, non-location equipment from
any other Methuselah`s ash heap to this minion. Put 3 Pathos counters
on that equipment. Burn a Pathos counter during each of your untap
phases. Remove the equipment from the game if it has no Pathos
counters. [NEC] As above, but the equipment can be unique.

Kiss of Lachesis
1 blood
+1 stealth action. [ser] (D) Burn a retainer or a non-unique equipment
card. [tem] (D) Burn a retainer, ally or non-unique equipment card.
[TEM] Move a non-unique equipment card from any Methuselah`s ash heap
to this vampire. If the equipment card comes from your ash heap, pay
half the cost (round down), otherwise no cost is paid.

Thanks,
Alex

Messages.Body:

>>Kiss of Lachesis and Flaming candle - there is a nice trick, especially
>>in a multiaction deck.
>
> There appears to be a single thread discussing this interaction
> (actually, it's about Filchware's and the Candle), and I cannot tell
> from the context there whether this combo (or the Grasp the Ghostly
> variant) actually works or not. LSJ?

When you find a thread on Google and want to discuss it, it helps
to provide a link.

Filchware is "equipping" (must meet requirements, etc.)

Kiss of Lachesis is "moving" (need not meet requirements, etc.)

Kissing a Candle works. Filching a Candle doesn't.

Grasping is also moving, so works.

> A corollary question: If using Grasp the Ghostly works, and you burn a
> Ghostly Candle to use its power, does the Candle go back to the (other
> Methuselah's) ash heap, or does the burning of the Candle also burn the
> Pathos counters and thus remove the Candle from the game entirely?

Once it burns, the "remove from the game" effect won't be able to find it.
